mission: VAN Unified Personal Intelligence + Cognitive Symbiosis (Rev 1 / Rev 1.1)

wip_audit.method: git rev-list --count origin/main..<branch> for every remote branch
wip_audit.finding: Every gpt/* implementation branch is an ancestor of main. No unique required implementation is stranded on any branch, so §52's post-merge certification already holds for them.

workstreams.name: Mission Core (MissionService, state machine)
workstreams.note: Mission Core on migration 10: missions/mission_activities/mission_events, deterministic state machine, VERIFIED_SUCCESS unreachable without a verifier receipt. Activities bind to the capability registry.

workstreams.name: Success contracts and verification
workstreams.note: Verifier adapters per capability class (API readback, repository SHA, CI run, ledger event, screenshot). EngineReportVerifier exists solely to make 'the worker said OK' always UNVERIFIABLE.

workstreams.name: Capability Registry (canonical)
workstreams.note: Canonical registry on migration 11 + registries/capabilities.json. Resolved the two-registry problem by splitting declaration from readiness: this registry declares, `readiness_source` delegates to the automation fabric / Google mesh / ExternalRuntimeRegistry that already owned that fact. No third copy of state.

workstreams.name: Capability Router / cognitive compression
workstreams.note: CapabilityRouter with policy as a hard pre-filter and pure arithmetic over declared facts. Route decisions persisted as evidence. Naming collision resolved: automation's router renamed AutomationMediumRouter (it selects the execution medium, not the capability).

workstreams.name: Context Compiler / ContextPacket
workstreams.note: ContextCompiler + ContextPacket. Hard cross-project isolation, stale claims carried but stripped of authority, contradiction groups kept together, budget enforced by deliberate drop order.

workstreams.name: Memory taxonomy (10 stores)
workstreams.note: Memory taxonomy: owner model, strategic, vocabulary, intent graph, complement map, growth ledger as separate stores. Procedural/anti-pattern remain.

workstreams.name: Owner Cognitive Model
workstreams.note: OwnerCognitiveModel with episode-independent admission. Autonomy-bearing fields never confirm from evidence alone.

workstreams.name: Decision fingerprints
workstreams.note: DecisionFingerprints with record_outcome, so an inferred reason can be falsified.

workstreams.name: Critical Reasoning Kernel
workstreams.note: CriticalReasoningKernel: solver/critic/verifier separation, mode-gated rigour, unsourced facts refused.

workstreams.name: Fact/inference/preference separation
workstreams.note: SemanticClass with is_factual_authority; FORBIDDEN_SELF_PROMOTIONS blocks inference becoming fact.

workstreams.name: Assumption Ledger
workstreams.note: AssumptionLedger with assert_safe_for_irreversible_work gate.

workstreams.name: Counterfactual engine
workstreams.note: REQUIRED_COUNTERFACTUALS + missing_counterfactuals reporting.

workstreams.name: Adversarial self-review / anti-sycophancy
workstreams.note: premise_assessments with derived agreed_without_evidence; sycophancy metrics measured, not claimed.

workstreams.name: Cognitive complement map
workstreams.note: CognitiveComplementMap; vulnerability candidates require task evidence.

workstreams.name: Shared vocabulary registry
workstreams.note: SharedVocabularyRegistry with anti-examples and project-scoped resolution.

workstreams.name: Intent continuity graph
workstreams.note: IntentContinuityGraph with conflicts/supersedes edges and staleness.

workstreams.name: Strategic memory
workstreams.note: StrategicMemory with already_rejected lookup.

workstreams.name: External reality model

workstreams.name: AI Evolution Radar

workstreams.name: VAN-specific benchmarking

workstreams.name: Attention Engine 2.0
workstreams.note: AttentionScorer in front of the existing queue: 5 dispositions, dedupe window, suppression recorded.

workstreams.name: Proactive missions + S0-S5 autonomy
workstreams.note: ProactivePolicyService + S0-S5 AutonomyLevel, domain-specific.

workstreams.name: Domain trust calibration
workstreams.note: DomainTrust; earned ceiling caps at S2, false success needs demonstrated recovery.

workstreams.name: Voice 2.0
workstreams.note: Wake pipeline, 'hie van' pre-rendered ack, PersonalSpeechModel, second-pass ASR fusion and signed transcript provenance all exist. Mission binding is the delta.

workstreams.name: Unified Android experience (6 surfaces)
workstreams.note: Data layer built: VanGatewayClient extended with the mission, understanding, permission, autonomy, radar and eval reads; MissionModels + MissionRepository provide the six surfaces' read models with owner-readable status strings. NOT COMPILED IN THIS CONTAINER — the Android Gradle Plugin does not resolve here, so the Kotlin is verified only by CI (:app:testDebugUnitTest). Compose screens themselves remain unwritten.

workstreams.name: Unified activity and evidence
workstreams.note: MissionEvent normalized; browser tasks and automation runs bind to Activities by reference via executor_ref. Backfill is idempotent and reversible. /v1/activity groups by mission; /v1/missions/{id}/evidence gathers receipts.

workstreams.name: Unified decisions
workstreams.note: DecisionService was already the single approval path; /v1/needs-you now presents waiting missions and open decisions as one surface.

workstreams.name: Privacy / permission registry
workstreams.note: PermissionRegistry: owner-readable grants with origin, expiry, last use, stale detection and revoke. Credential-shaped material and unlisted permissions are refused.

workstreams.name: Durable orchestration (Temporal)
workstreams.note: Temporal is stack-locked at adoption phase 11 and NOT deployed. automation/router.py already routes critical_durable to TEMPORAL with an honest 'not yet built' detail.

workstreams.name: Computer Interaction Fabric
workstreams.note: ComputerInteractionFabric: closed set of typed operations (no RUN_ARBITRARY/EXECUTE/EVAL), per-type action ceilings, never A4 on any surface, browser boundary vocabulary reused unchanged.

workstreams.name: Development missions
workstreams.note: Development missions served by RepositoryShaVerifier and CiRunVerifier through the same success-contract interface as every other capability class.

workstreams.name: VanEval
workstreams.note: VanEval across 11 dimensions; reports unmeasured rather than a flattering pass.

resolved_findings: Two capability registries: resolved by declaration/readiness split rather than merge.
CapabilityRouter name collision: automation's is now AutomationMediumRouter.
knowledge/vekl.py's /v1/missions/{mission_id}/vekl contract now has a Mission entity behind it.
owner_decisions_made_on_behalf: Context token budget 8000, ~4 chars/token estimate (not a tokenizer call).
Claim TTLs per semantic class; owner preferences never expire on a clock.
Owner model: 2 independent episodes -> CANDIDATE, 3 -> CONFIRMED; autonomy-bearing fields never auto-confirm.
Independence counted by episode, not observation.
Earned autonomy caps at S2 (prepare); every executing level needs an owner grant.
A false success requires demonstrated recovery, not just netting against past wins.
Attention thresholds 0.75/0.55/0.35/0.15 and a 1h dedupe window.
Strategy PREFERRED needs 10 runs at >=90%; demotion at <60% over >=3 runs.
Intent goes STALE after 90 days unmentioned; only the owner abandons one.
3 eval dimensions declared unmeasurable without owner ground truth rather than estimated.

remaining.WS33: Durable orchestration — Temporal is stack-locked at adoption phase 11 and not deployed. External gate by your own governance.
